exact_claim: The frozen representation-and-repair candidate (cut representation cross_2, identity b1ac10462bf5dab3) scores more edges than the strongest frozen fixed baseline on a custodian-held CONFIRM panel of triangle_free_host_v1 hosts drawn from the adopted calibration, by at least the minimum useful effect, under the registered analysis.
exposure_policy: Custodian-built exposure registry; isomorphism and near-duplicate screening against every DEV panel named in B16–B19 evidence; a CONFIRM panel is retired after its one use.

raw_evidence_custody: Custodian private evidence store; the judge recomputes the analysis; the custodian publishes a signed registration log.
rejection_criteria: Any decision-record or plan check failing; an evaluator that cannot run the candidate; registration beyond the declared family size; an INVALID or NOT_SUPPORTED outcome.
